superdamage.def: A temporary or conditional increase to your Super's damage.

overshieldgeneric.def: An overshield that isn't the Void Overshield buff (e.g. from exotic armor); extra health on top of your shields.
overshieldgeneric.q: Killing the highlighted enemy grants Vengeance, which is a 95 HP Overshield, for 6 seconds.

shotgun.def: Shotgun weapons; some pieces trigger on shotgun kills or boost shotgun damage.
shotgun.q: Shotgun and melee final blows start your health regeneration.

submachinegun.def: Submachine Gun weapons; some pieces buff them or trigger on them.
submachinegun.q: While wielding a Submachine Gun, handling, airborne effectiveness, and movement are all improved

autorifle.def: Auto Rifle weapons; some pieces buff them or trigger on their kills.
autorifle.q: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves.

machinegun.def: Machine Gun weapons; some pieces buff them or trigger on their kills.
machinegun.q: Steadily reloads a portion of your equipped Auto Rifle or Machine Gun's magazine from reserves.

rocketlauncher.def: Rocket Launchers and other rocket/micro-missile weapons; some pieces boost their damage.
rocketlauncher.q: Damaging targets with Exodus micro-missiles temporarily increases the damage you deal with other micro-missiles and Rocket Launchers.
